purpose: Reproducible development comparison; not public capacity or SLA

mixed.transports: alternating practice and registered live contest; one shared admission pool

method.percentile: nearest rank ceil(N*p), no interpolation; report N
method.queue: persisted CreatedAtUtc to first StartedAtUtc; UTC clock
method.completion: monotonic admission-response to observed terminal owner read, 100-ms polling
method.api: in-process ASP.NET HTTP owner reads plus catalog requests during Worker activity; excludes TLS/network
method.resourceSampling: bounded Engine one-shot stats every 2 seconds, only fixture project and owned-volume sandboxes; sampled peaks may miss short stages
method.disk: fixture workspace volume df and du; excludes PostgreSQL/private-artifact storage and Docker image layers
method.warmth: images cached, fresh fixture database/volume; each case initializes a fresh executor; first case JIT-cold, following cases process-warm
method.limits: CPU fixture uses bounded arithmetic work; compilation separate 512MiB; memory/output fixtures deliberately fail every test
